title: lithachne axillaris
intro: Lithachne axillaris, commonly known as Java grass, is a type of plant native to tropical regions. It has been used for its medicinal properties and is known to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help in reducing fever, alleviating pain, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Java grass include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Lithachne axillaris include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
